docs.purpose: Lets an admin start one of the automated data-collection pipelines — permits, committee-of-adjustment applications, sources, entities, or deep scrapes — by triggering it on GitHub Actions, or cancel it while it is running.
docs.data_story: It reads 1 table — `pipeline_runs` and writes `pipeline_runs`. Its response is an explicit pick-by-name projection of 6 fields, so a column added to a table upstream does not leak into the client by accident. It is called from 1 place: `admin_data_quality`. It mutates admin state and writes **no `admin_audit_log` row** — one of the nine measured gaps Phase 0 closes.
docs.under_126: Becomes a **CONTRACT descriptor** of archetype `COMMAND`. It declares the JOB it triggers (`job_ref`), its concurrency posture and the audit row it must write. Its `consumers[]` becomes the edge list of the fan-out graph — the join nothing in this estate holds today.

notes: NO writeAdminAudit anywhere in this file — dispatching or cancelling a pipeline run is unaudited. Only 5 chain slugs are dispatchable; individual-step runs are rejected on cloud. The pre-dispatch already-running guard fails OPEN on a DB error. DELETE marks ALL matching pipeline_runs rows (chain rows and their '<chain>:<step>%' scoped step rows) cancelled unconditionally, not gated on the GitHub cancel succeeding. Called via a template literal (`/api/admin/pipelines/${slug}`) from DataQualityDashboard.tsx. | MEASURED 2026-09-15: No `SPEC LINK` header; the file's doc comment references 'Spec 113 §8 / D8' at :12 (a comment, not a header directive) and src/lib/admin/github-dispatch.ts:3-4 carries the real SPEC LINK (Specs 115 §3/§8, 113 §8). Census (reads pipeline_runs / writes pipeline_runs) CONFIRMED; census missed `profiles` via the guard. Two behaviours a reviewer must know: (1) the 409 concurrency guard is deliberately FAIL-OPEN — a DB error on the probe is logged and the dispatch proceeds (:108-112), so double-dispatch is possible during a DB blip; (2) the pipeline_runs UPDATE at :154-161 is UNCONDITIONAL on the GitHub cancel succeeding (comment at :149-153 states this is intentional because run-chain.js polls its own row), so rows can be marked 'cancelled' while the GH run is not. The UPDATE's second predicate builds LIKE patterns by stripping the 'chain_' prefix (:160) — `chain_coa` -> `coa:%`, which will also match any future pipeline slug beginning `coa:`. `fail()` accepts an unconstrained number status (:47) unlike the shared err()'s ErrorStatus union. | Caching: none observed — no dynamic/revalidate/Cache-Control under src/app/api/admin/pipelines/ (grep returned nothing) | Other guards / classification: CSRF Origin allowlist DOES apply here (POST/DELETE are in MUTATING_METHODS, src/lib/auth/verify-admin.ts:45,70-78; allowlist parsed from ADMIN_ALLOWED_ORIGINS, default-deny at :336). Application-level concurrency guard (not a security guard): anyChainRunning() 409 at :105-107. MFA gate at src/lib/auth/verify-admin.ts:143-173 (inert unless ADMIN_MFA_ENFORCED). | Locking tests: src/tests/admin-pipeline-dispatch.logic.test.ts, src/tests/admin.ui.test.tsx, src/tests/chain.logic.test.ts, src/tests/inspections.logic.test.ts.
